scenarios.title: Heading map navigation, state, viewport and search
steps: Open Heading map from Document outline and from the command palette. Compare heading numbers, skipped levels and direct-child counts with the source; captions must not be counted.
Collapse and expand Research, select a heading subtree, return to the document, then search Question A inside a collapsed branch. Toggle the search-revealed branch and clear the search.

Pan the blank canvas in both directions, zoom using buttons and Fit. On desktop also use ordinary wheel and Ctrl/Cmd-wheel at the canvas boundaries, and Tab/Enter navigation. On Android use touch pan, cancel a drag, and verify controls in a narrow portrait viewport.

Rename a selected/collapsed heading in the editor, then insert a new Repeated heading before the existing sections. Confirm state stays with the original section. On desktop switch rapidly between two panes of the same note and navigate from the map back to the originating pane.
expected: Each card has the effective number or Hn and the unchanged direct-child total; leaves show a disabled zero handle. Map-only operations leave Markdown bytes unchanged.
Renames and source insertions preserve unambiguously matched selection, subtree scope and collapse state; delayed old-pane buffers never replace the active source snapshot.

Zoom keeps the pointer or viewport-center anchor fixed, including small trees and all canvas boundaries. Collapse/expand keeps the clicked parent at the same screen position. Fit centers the tree and narrow toolbars wrap without hiding controls.

Search reveals matches, the handle announces the effective expanded state, temporary search toggles work, and clearing search restores saved collapse intent. Keyboard focus remains usable and navigation targets the correct source line.

scenarios.title: Virtual numbering, previewed writes, cleanup, captions, and references
steps: Verify virtual numbering and caption rendering without changing fixture bytes
Place the selection in either of the two explicit same-file references and verify only that source syntax is revealed
Preview Write, confirm it, then preview and confirm Cleanup
expected: Virtual display and IME composition never invoke Editor or Vault writes
Only the selected explicit reference source is revealed in Live Preview
Write and Cleanup are preview-first and preserve fenced pseudo-headings and unrelated frontmatter

scenarios.title: Protected YAML, HTML and inline comments
steps: Open Protected source, inspect outline, caption code and visible note references; preview Write and apply, then undo.
expected: Only Real heading and Child participate in heading numbering; YAML scalar and HTML content remain unchanged. The visible Figure title retains foo(), and only the two references outside the multiline comment are numbered.

scenarios.title: Continuous current-note edits
steps: Open Current note on Controls; enter H1 first number 123 rapidly and H2 skip first 2, commit by blur, change virtual and conceal overrides, then reopen the panel.

Enter an invalid H1 value and verify inline feedback without a save; correct it. Run Simulate concurrent H1 change on next note save, then commit H1 value 3. Retry, inspect saved 7 versus draft 3, and explicitly apply the draft or discard and reload.
expected: The final numbers and both overrides persist, the active input remains usable, and the save status settles to Saved without lost input. Invalid numeric text does not save, and Retry alone never overwrites a divergent same-field edit.

scenarios.title: Navigation, preview state and long notes
steps: Open Long document, edit a heading and inspect image tooltips. Navigate outline entries and expand/collapse sections using the available input method. On desktop open the same file twice and navigate from the second pane.

Open Controls in one pane. Run the fixture command Delay next preview apply for 20 seconds, then preview Write and confirm. Inspect Applying and attempt dismissal during the delay; wait for normal completion. The provider is inert until explicitly armed and is excluded from release assets.
expected: Navigation reaches the intended heading and retains the originating desktop pane. Outline buttons keep usable focus. Tooltip content updates without visible interaction stalls. Dismissal cannot imply cancellation after applying begins.
